summary: Built and maintained a mobile app used to inventory public infrastructure across Madagascar for the Ministry of Public Works (MTP).
highlights: Created the React Native app used by field agents to record roads, bridges and other infrastructure
Built data-entry forms with photos and GPS position for each surveyed asset
Made the app usable offline, with data sent to the server once a connection is back
Maintained and extended the app over two years as the ministry's needs changed

projects.name: MTP infrastructure inventory
projects.description: Field app for the Ministry of Public Works to survey and catalogue the country's infrastructure.
